title: Spiking Neural Networks Incrementally Track Firing-Rate Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.27322v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how spiking neural networks (SNNs) efficiently process data streams is key to (i) studying how biological brains conserve energy for lifelong predictions and (ii) enabling efficient continuous AI inference. In this work, we propose a theory on how an SNN incrementally tracks its corresponding firing-rate network, a continuous-valued neural network (ANN). We prove that the output of a discrete SNN continuously tracks the instantaneous ANN output implicitly determined by the SNN input. Based on this principle, we develop LIF-Stream, a conversion framework for efficient SNN inference over unbounded data streams. It enables the converted SNN to reuse its prior activation state and compute only the activation updates between frames, thereby reducing the average number of time steps needed per frame. Specifically, LIF-Stream controls the SNN to continuously track the reference ANN output, which gives a high-accuracy prediction

translated_title: 脉冲神经网络增量跟踪发放率网络
translated_abstract: 理解脉冲神经网络（SNN）如何高效处理数据流，对于（i）研究生物大脑如何为终身预测节约能量，以及（ii）实现高效的连续AI推理都至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个关于SNN如何增量跟踪其对应的发放率网络（一种连续值神经网络ANN）的理论。我们证明了离散SNN的输出能够持续跟踪由SNN输入隐式确定的瞬时ANN输出。基于这一原理，我们开发了LIF-Stream，这是一个用于在无界数据流上进行高效SNN推理的转换框架。它使转换后的SNN能够复用先前的激活状态，仅计算帧间的激活更新，从而减少了每帧所需的平均时间步数。具体而言，LIF-Stream控制SNN持续跟踪参考ANN的输出，从而给出高精度的预测。
tldr: 提出了基于SNN增量跟踪发放率网络理论的LIF-Stream转换框架，使转换后的脉冲神经网络能够复用先前激活状态并仅计算帧间激活更新，从而在无界数据流上实现高效且高精度的SNN推理。
en_tdlr: Proposes LIF-Stream, a conversion framework based on the theory that SNNs incrementally track their firing-rate networks, enabling converted SNNs to reuse prior activation states and compute only inter-frame activation updates for efficient and accurate inference on unbounded data streams.
